name: Cypress
one_liner: In-browser end-to-end testing with an excellent debugging experience, now pressured by Playwright.
what_it_is: An end-to-end testing framework that runs tests inside the browser alongside the application, with a time-travelling test runner UI that lets you step back through each command and inspect the DOM at that moment.
why_it_matters: Cypress made end-to-end testing approachable when the alternative was Selenium, and its debugging experience is still genuinely good. It is marked declining for specific reasons rather than fashion: running inside the browser constrains its handling of multiple tabs, multiple origins and true cross-browser coverage, and Playwright addressed those while matching the debugging story. An existing Cypress suite is not a problem to solve; choosing it for new work now needs a reason.
suitable_for: Existing suites that are working and maintained
Teams that particularly value its interactive test runner
Single-origin applications where its architectural limits do not bite
not_suitable_for: Testing flows that cross origins or involve multiple tabs
New end-to-end suites, where Playwright is the stronger default
